content: Delivered: Replaced all 4 bcf_hdr_id2int FFI call sites (name2rid, tag_type, name_to_id, sample_to_id) with pure Rust HashMap lookups. HeaderView now pre-builds three HashMap<Vec<u8>, i32> caches (one per BCF_DT_* dictionary) at construction time from the hdr->id[] arrays, giving O(1) lookups without touching the opaque C khash. 7 differential proptests (6 property-based + 1 real VCF file) verify equivalence with C oracle. All 224 tests pass, clippy clean.
